title: Osiris Shaft water samples tested with the Osirion 7 mission

tellings.quote: we've actually taken samples of the water in the Osiris Shaft and I had that tested in conjunction with an archaeological project that I'm a member of called the Osirion 7 archaeological mission in conjunction with Jim Westerman to investigate the source of the water within the Osirion.

plain: Water from the Osiris Shaft, a deep flooded shaft under the Giza plateau in Egypt, has been sampled and tested, according to Jeffrey Drum, a researcher who argues the pyramids once worked as an energy system and who says he took part. Drum tells Michels he had the water tested through an archaeological project he belongs to, the Osirion 7 mission, run with a man named Jim Westerman to find out where the water in the Osirion, an ancient Egyptian site, comes from. He brings it up as evidence for his ideas about how the pyramid complex used water.
